notes.title: HOPSHOT Release Day!
notes.content:
HOPSHOT has now fully released to the public!
It now has 12 sections, 37 achievements, 15 secret cosmetics, 9 language options, and 3 different endings!

Also for the speedrunners: You can press Ctrl + Shift + 8 to enter "Cheat Mode" which invalidates the in-game timer but allows you to fly around to practice whichever sections you like!

- Please continue to submit feedback and bug reports as they will help improve the game for all! :D
